scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @table-check/core && npm run build -w @table-check/web
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.33.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-minopal "node scripts/feedback-rules.test.mjs"
scripts.ios-swift:open: cd apps/ios-swift && xcodegen generate && open Minopal.xcodeproj
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules -P prod
scripts.deploy:store: npm run typecheck -w @table-check/core && STORE_DEPLOY=1 npm run build -w @table-check/web -- --mode development && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules -P dev
